### `/bin/wifi_pingtest.sh`

````diff
--- a//bin/wifi_pingtest.sh
+++ b//bin/wifi_pingtest.sh
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 #!/system/bin/sh
 
-#pcie is used by dji_perception, must stop it on V1/E2
-stop dji_perception
-adb shell stop dji_perception
+#pcie is used by perception, must stop it on V1/E2
+stop perception
+adb shell stop perception
 
 echo low > /sys/devices/platform/soc/f8100000.apb/f9b10000.pcie/mode
 sleep 1
````
